modernization.charts: Motor, temperature and power history charts
modernization.motorSnapshotScope: Latest returned motor snapshot; reported source: {{source}}. Observation freshness and continuous coverage are not established. HV isolation comes from the separate live signal state.
modernization.powerMethodology: Peak-labelled power uses average drive power from up to 30 returned drives. Per-drive regen power is not supplied; gaps are unknown, not zero.
modernization.healthMethodology: Health temperatures are backend battery-module proxies, not direct motor measurements.
modernization.driveSubset: Recent drives within the selected range
modernization.noAssessment: No temperature evidence for an active health assessment
modernization.scorePolicy: Status-to-score policy: good 95%, warning 60%, critical 25%. This is a rating, not a measured percentage.
modernization.snapshotNotLive: A health response is a snapshot; it does not establish an active telemetry connection.
modernization.statsScope: Unbounded vehicle statistics; independent of the chart date filter.
modernization.recordScope: These details contain every field of the plotted records, including unknown signals. Motor history retains source order; drives retain chronological order and the existing 30-record cap.
modernization.isolationPolicy: HV isolation bands are 500 kΩ and 100 kΩ. Non-positive readings use the existing unknown policy.
modernization.proxyFront: The health endpoint projects the minimum battery-module temperature into the front motor temperature field.
modernization.proxyRear: The health endpoint projects the maximum battery-module temperature into the rear motor temperature field.
modernization.proxyInverter: The health endpoint adds a 7°C temperature difference to the maximum battery-module reading as an inverter proxy.
modernization.proxyBattery: The health endpoint averages the available minimum and maximum module readings, or uses the single available reading.
modernization.backendPolicy: The backend reports warning above {{warm}} and critical above {{critical}}, based on its maximum module/inverter proxy. These thresholds differ from the per-component gauge ratios.
modernization.gaugePolicy: Component gauges compare Celsius readings with their original ceilings: {{motor}} for front/rear motor, {{inverter}} for inverter and {{battery}} for battery. Warning begins at 65% and critical at 85% of the ceiling.
modernization.statorAliases: Existing Stator, Rear-Left and Rear-Right series map to front motor, rear motor and inverter temperature respectively. These aliases do not identify additional motors.
modernization.statorHistorySummary: Front motor, rear motor and inverter temperature over returned motor snapshots, displayed under the existing stator series aliases.
modernization.torqueHistoryDescription: Torque uses the front motor reading when supplied, otherwise the rear motor reading, in newton-metres. Missing readings remain gaps, not zero.
modernization.historyScope: Motor history uses the existing 200-snapshot request in source order. The date range filters returned drives, not motor history or vehicle drive statistics.
modernization.averageCoverage: Average power requires a power reading for every included drive. An incomplete set remains unknown rather than treating missing readings as zero.
modernization.unknownPolicy: Without temperature evidence, no active health assessment is presented. A returned status is still recorded as source data.
modernization.generalAdvice: No active assessment is available. General care recommendations remain available below.
modernization.selectedStatisticsBounds: Drive start in {{range}} (start inclusive, end exclusive)
modernization.completedStatisticsPopulation: Server statistics cover all completed drives for the selected vehicle whose start falls within the selected bounds, not just the returned drive subset.
modernization.separateHistoryPolicies: Motor history uses the existing unbounded 200-snapshot request in source order, independent of the selected range. Drive charts and power use the last 30 returned drives within the selected range; this subset is separate from the full completed-drive statistics.

alert.criticalMsg: One or more drivetrain components are operating at critically high temperatures. Immediate attention is recommended.
alert.warningMsg: Drivetrain temperatures are above normal operating range. Monitor closely and consider reducing load.

drivetrain.noHealth: No drivetrain health data available yet
drivetrain.noSensors: No temperature sensor data available yet

drivetrain.torqueHistorySub: Drive inverter torque output over time
drivetrain.title: Drivetrain health
drivetrain.subtitle: Motor, inverter, and battery thermal status

brief.powerScope: Loaded recent drives, not a complete selected-range power aggregate.

tips.criticalStop: Temperatures are critically high. Consider pulling over safely and letting the vehicle cool down.
tips.serviceUrgent: Schedule an urgent service appointment. Critical temperatures may indicate a coolant system issue.
tips.reduceLoad: Reduce driving intensity and avoid hard acceleration to allow components to cool.
tips.checkCoolant: Schedule a service appointment to inspect the coolant system and fluid levels.
tips.avoidSupercharging: Avoid Supercharging while temperatures are elevated. Use Level 2 charging instead.
tips.regularService: Keep up with regular service intervals for optimal drivetrain health and longevity.
tips.gentleAccel: Gentle acceleration helps maintain lower motor temperatures and extends component life.
tips.precondition: Precondition the battery in cold weather for better thermal performance and driving efficiency.
tips.monitorTemps: Monitor drivetrain temperatures after spirited driving sessions or long highway stretches.
